rule: one merged pull request; head = its merge commit (what the target branch became when it landed, a squash and a merge commit alike) and base = that commit's first parent, which is the target branch as it stood the moment before and therefore merge-base(head, target branch at merge time). The diff base..head is exactly what the pull request contributed.
